description: Ham Radio Village explores amateur radio communications, emergency mesh networking (AREDN), satellite contacts, low-power RF propagation, and digital radio modes.

talks.title: Spectrum Coordination for Amateur Radio
talks.teaser: Bryan Fields explains frequency allocation and spectrum coordination mechanisms in amateur radio, covering repeater frequency pairs and interference mitigation.

talks.title: How to Contact the ISS with a $30 Radio
talks.teaser: Gregg Horton demonstrates tracking orbital passes and making two-way amateur radio contacts with the International Space Station using budget handheld radios.

talks.title: Getting Started with Low Power / Long Distance Comms
talks.teaser: Eric Escobar shares foundational techniques for low-power (QRP) and long-range RF communications, leveraging LoRa, directional antennas, and digital protocols.

talks.title: An Introduction to RF Test Equipment
talks.teaser: Kurtis Kopf introduces essential RF testing instruments—including vector network analyzers (VNAs), spectrum analyzers, and power meters—for hardware hackers.

talks.title: Amateur Radio Mesh Networking
talks.teaser: Tyler Gardner explores high-speed amateur radio mesh networking (AREDN), building resilient IP-based emergency communication backbones on ham frequencies.

talks.title: Amateur Radio Digital Modes Primer
talks.teaser: Jon Marler breaks down modern amateur radio digital modes (FT8, JS8Call, APRS), demonstrating keyboard-to-keyboard data transmission over high frequencies.
